HeartFlow v3.0.0 — Major AI cognition upgrade

- Added AI self-reflection, dream synthesis, and emergent personality as core cognitive features.
- Introduced multi-layer memory (CORE/LEARNED/EPHEMERAL) and event-driven personality tracking.
- Embedded new psychology and philosophy layers for self-positioning, development, and being.
- Enhanced learning via self-healing RL and advanced Dream Engine (v4.1) for synthesis and insight generation.
- New system interfaces, tools, and security measures for memory, state tracking, and safe operation.
- Expanded module structure for judgment, memory, reasoning, metaphor, commonsense, and verification.
